name: Soybean Forward Curve, Carry Regime & Contango Frequency
description: ZS-only term structure analysis. Uses NoAdjustment futures continuation with spread_depth=1 to compute carry (M1/M2 - 1), calendar spread (M1 - M2), contango/backwardation regime flags, rolling 63-day contango frequency, and expanding seasonal contango frequency per calendar month.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SOYBEAN (ZS) FORWARD CURVE, CARRY REGIME & CONTANGO FREQUENCY
# =============================================================================
#
# Pure ZC term structure dashboard:
#   - carry = cont.carry  (M1/M2 - 1; positive=backwardation, negative=contango)
#   - spread = cont.spread (M1 - M2 price spread via spread_depth=1)
#   - Contango regime flags and rolling/seasonal contango frequency
#
# Adjustment: NoAdjustment preserves real price levels for term structure analysis.
# Rollover: FirstOfMonth for predictable roll dates.
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: ZC Corn Futures ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

carry = cont.carry       # M1/M2 - 1 (positive=backwardation, negative=contango)
spread = cont.spread     # M1 - M2 in dollars

# --- Regime Flags ---
is_contango = carry < 0
is_backwardation = carry > 0

# --- Regime Label (string for summary table) ---
regime_label = conditional_select(is_backwardation, "Backwardation", "Contango")

# --- Rolling 63-day Contango Frequency ---
# Boolean auto-casts to 0/1; ma gives rolling fraction
contango_freq_63d = ma(period=63)(is_contango)

# --- All-History Contango Frequency (expanding mean) ---
contango_freq_all = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(is_contango)

# --- Calendar Month Extraction ---
ts = index()
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)

# --- Seasonal Contango Frequency per Calendar Month (expanding mean) ---
is_jan = month_num == 1
is_feb = month_num == 2
is_mar = month_num == 3
is_apr = month_num == 4
is_may = month_num == 5
is_jun = month_num == 6
is_jul = month_num == 7
is_aug = month_num == 8
is_sep = month_num == 9
is_oct = month_num == 10
is_nov = month_num == 11
is_dec = month_num == 12

jan_cf = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_jan, is_contango)))
feb_cf = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_feb, is_contango)))
mar_cf = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_mar, is_contango)))
apr_cf = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_apr, is_contango)))
may_cf = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_may, is_contango)))
jun_cf = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_jun, is_contango)))
jul_cf = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_jul, is_contango)))
aug_cf = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_aug, is_contango)))
sep_cf = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_sep, is_contango)))
oct_cf = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_oct, is_contango)))
nov_cf = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_nov, is_contango)))
dec_cf = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_dec, is_contango)))

seasonal_contango = conditional_select(
    is_jan, jan_cf,
    is_feb, feb_cf,
    is_mar, mar_cf,
    is_apr, apr_cf,
    is_may, may_cf,
    is_jun, jun_cf,
    is_jul, jul_cf,
    is_aug, aug_cf,
    is_sep, sep_cf,
    is_oct, oct_cf,
    is_nov, nov_cf,
    dec_cf
)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Snapshot Table
# Row 0: Carry & Spread
# Row 1: Regime & Contango Frequency
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Soybean (ZS) Forward Curve Snapshot',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Term Structure', 'Contango Frequency'],
        col_headers=['Carry (M1/M2-1)', 'Spread (M1-M2)', 'Current Regime'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(info='Current carry: positive=backwardation, negative=contango', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='M1 minus M2 price spread in dollars', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Backwardation if carry>0, Contango if carry<0', grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.TextFormat),
            ColumnSpec(info='Rolling 63-day contango frequency', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(info='All-history expanding contango frequency', grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(info='Current month seasonal contango frequency', grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Snapshot'
)(carry, spread, regime_label, contango_freq_63d, contango_freq_all, seasonal_contango)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Carry % Over Time with Zero Reference Line
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Soybean Carry (M1/M2 - 1): Backwardation > 0, Contango < 0',
    category='2. Carry & Regime',
    y_axis_label='Carry',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Carry', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(carry,))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Seasonal Contango Frequency by Calendar Month (Bar Chart)
# Shows average fraction of days in contango per month (Jan-Dec)
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Seasonal Contango Frequency by Month',
    category='3. Contango Frequency',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_axis_label='Month',
    y_axis_label='Contango Frequency',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    data_labels=True,
    order=2
)(values=is_contango, label=month_num)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 4: Rolling 63-Day Contango Frequency Over Time
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Rolling 63-Day Contango Frequency',
    category='3. Contango Frequency',
    y_axis_label='Contango Frequency',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50%')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='63d Contango Freq', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=3
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(contango_freq_63d,))
